set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically.

Problem
A panel that shows an image or a screen-sized frame must keep its aspect ratio at any host size. Today the host has to letterbox by hand: there is no aspect-preserving viewport, and inset extents are refused (tracked separately in bd-01M3F97R1S9A0NVKHZGTFN8ZJ2).

Scope
A viewport mode, Fit or Fill with alignment, that preserves the data aspect ratio inside its extent. The mode is exposed in the resolved viewport frames, so picking and inverse mapping stay consistent.

Acceptance criteria
1. A 16:9 frame in a 4:3 extent is letterboxed with the requested alignment, on every backend.
2. The resolved frame and the inverse mapping match the drawn image (conformance scene).
3. Resizing keeps the aspect ratio exactly.
set.title: [Intaglio] Aspect-preserving viewport (fit/fill with letterbox) for image-backed panels
